## Metric selection

1 candidate, 1 selected. Scores run from 1 (poor) to 5 (strong); the weighted score is the average of the scores by criterion weight.

Target: between 1 and 8 selected metrics.

### Indicators

| Indicator | Status | Decision value | Cost to collect (lower is better) | Weighted score | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Identity providers with generally available support (`ind-idp-count`) | Selected | 5 | 2 | 4.60 | Cheap to compute and directly tied to the outcome. |
| Providers with the standard on their public roadmap (`ind-idp-roadmaps`) | Candidate | 3 | — | 3.00 | — |

### Outcome priorities

| Outcome | Equity | Evidence of what works | Weighted score | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Major identity providers support the standard (`oc-idp-support`) | 4 | 3 | 3.67 | Highest leverage on adoption. |

### Intervention priorities

| Intervention | Feasibility | Weighted score | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Run interoperability events (`int-interop`) | 5 | 5.00 | Can start now with existing partners. |
